title: Pelayo Sands
meta_description: Pelayo Sands is your sunlit Santa Rosa Beach stay---steps from 30A, with a private pool, coastal views, and bright interiors made for laid-back luxury.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Pelayo Sands --- your sunlit slice of paradise just steps from the sandy shores of Santa Rosa Beach.
Perfectly positioned for easy beach days and laid-back afternoons by the pool, this bright and breezy 3-bedroom, 3-bath home blends comfort, style, and unbeatable location for your next Florida getaway.

Inside, the open-concept design invites connection, with the living room, dining space, and fully equipped kitchen flowing seamlessly together. Whether you're prepping a coastal feast or unwinding after a sun-soaked day, every corner is thoughtfully designed for easy, elevated living. The bedrooms offer serene retreats, including a playful bunk-and-queen room with its own ensuite bath --- ideal for families or groups.

For even more ways to relax, head up to the third-floor perch, where you can soak in the salty air and coastal views with your morning coffee or evening glass of wine. Outside, the private pool area beckons with lounge chairs, a BBQ grill, and plenty of space to savor the Florida sunshine. With washer/dryer access, parking, and all the comforts of home, your stay is as effortless as it is memorable.

Set within walking distance to the beach and a quick drive to local favorites like Gulf Place Town Center, Blue Mountain Beach eateries, and the charming shops along 30A, this home offers the perfect launchpad for adventure --- or pure relaxation.

Santa Rosa Beach is a laid-back coastal community along scenic 30A, known for its sugar-white beaches, emerald waters, and charming local spots. With easy access to neighboring beach towns, parks, and trails, it's the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure.

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Information:
- This property offers parking for up to 4 vehicles in the driveway.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.
